ownership_and_errors: TextEdit, NumberField, ColorField, Slider, and Dropdown own bounded strings. WidgetCanvas borrows caller RGBA and an optional FnMut draw closure; WidgetDrawSpec borrows text and segment labels. Constructors and mutations report invalid inputs with Option or bool; key operations use InputResult; painting returns bool. No unsafe code or dependency added.
safe_adaptations: C pointer plus explicit length inputs use valid Rust str slices; byte lengths remain UTF-8 byte lengths.
C formatted output buffers become owned String results, with formatting failure represented as None where numeric formatting can fail.
C callback/context pair becomes a borrowed FnMut closure; scalar_text_draw is the fallback when absent.
C fixed dropdown option array becomes bounded Vec<String>; segment labels are a bounded borrowed slice with explicit segment_count.
Invalid/overflowing coordinate expansion is rejected before writes; Rust slice length is checked against declared canvas capacity.
Number parsing preserves the C decimal grammar and rejects nonzero values rounded to zero or below f64::MIN_POSITIVE, matching strtod ERANGE underflow without locale or native shims.

widget_geometry.rs replaces the arbitrary 128-point margin with a side-effect-free pass through the actual per-kind paint_component geometry. Local offsets are translated to the caller origin with checked additions and the C scaled_rect endpoint rules before rasterization or callbacks. Primitive public methods use the same scaled_rect rules directly. No geometry is wrapped or saturated into visible coordinates.

C limits TreeRow guides to six but applies the full u8 indent to the content origin. This distinction is preserved and tested at indent 255. C focus-ring left/top clamps and skip-on-overflow behavior are preserved; a valid Label callback is not rejected because an optional ring cannot be represented.

maps.coverage: UTF-8 scalar insertion, selection replacement and invalid boundaries, 127-byte rejection, commit/cancel, strict finite number grammar and formatting including underflow-to-zero/subnormal rejection, valid zero and minimum-normal boundaries, option/shift stepping and scrub, RGBA short/long hex, slider snapping, dropdown wrap/commit/cancel, disabled/focus/pointer states. Character bytes are preserved; only U+0000..U+001F and U+007F are rejected as typed controls.
Checked capacity/stride and multiplication, 16384 axis, backing/UI scale, theme via Theme, 100..200 text scale by 25. Canvas borrows RGBA and closure.

All WidgetKind paint dispatches, control-state colors, transition interpolation, focus ring, 4x4 rounded-edge coverage, icon masks, text font/weight/size/color, text fallback, input selection/cursor, toast cap, invalid no-write buffer construction, EmptyState narrow-bounds failure with unchanged buffer, direct EmptyState and TreeRow near-u32::MAX offset rejection without panic or buffer mutation, narrow segmented zero-width selection exact-pixel parity, and zero scratch limit. All public primitive overflow entries and every named widget kind reject invalid endpoint geometry without buffer mutation; scale-1 Label x=u32::MAX-64,width=16 reaches its callback exactly once per call. Wide signed line coordinates prevent off-canvas chevrons/checks from wrapping through i32.

Transition backgrounds and selection edge, indentation guides, visibility/disclosure/icon/action states, #identifier split and UTF-8-safe <=63-byte ellipses, responsive empty-state sizes/icons/text, and safe failure before writes when the C icon centering subtraction would wrap. Direct TreeRow indent=255 near u32::MAX rejects checked content overflow; ordinary indent=255 content starts at x=3612 while only six guides paint. Direct EmptyState/TreeRow use the same per-kind validation as widget_paint.
